Implemented `addPath()` and `layout()` in web/scene/filetree.js. Paths split on "/", one node per level up to 4 (deeper segments collapse into level 4), hard stop at 40 nodes, dedupe by path key. Directories are 0.06 m wire cubes, files 0.05 m planes with a filename sprite; levels sit 0.35 m apart below the root, siblings 0.25 m apart sorted by name so the tree never reshuffles; parent→child edges are one LineSegments. `node --check` passes; 67 lines. Nothing else touched.

Add showDiff(unifiedDiff, path) to web/scene/filetree.js: a 0.8×0.5 m plane at x = +1.2 m from the root at y = 1.2 that renders at most 24 lines of the diff on a canvas texture — lines starting with "+" in #22C55E, "−" in #EF4444, headers and context in gray — visible for 8 s or until the next call, and mark the touched node green with a touched-count badge. Reuse the canvas-text helper. Verify with node --check.

Context: The tree builder from the previous task is in place: nodes Map keyed by path with { mesh, depth, children, touched }. tool.complete events carry meta.diff (unified) and meta.path. Keep it under 120 lines; no new dependencies.
